contribution_policy.ai_generated_contributions: restricted (no AI-generated prose in issues or PRs)

from_source.notes: The repository has no root CMakeLists.txt. Build a static library named imgui from imgui.cpp, imgui_draw.cpp, imgui_tables.cpp, imgui_widgets.cpp, imgui_demo.cpp, and for the SDL3 pairing backends/imgui_impl_sdl3.cpp and backends/imgui_impl_sdlgpu3.cpp; include directories: the repo root and backends/; link SDL3::SDL3. Core and backends must come from the same commit.

variants.name: docking
variants.notes: Docking and multi-viewports exist only on the docking branch.

allocation.hook: ImGui::SetAllocatorFunctions(ImGuiMemAllocFunc alloc, ImGuiMemFreeFunc free, void* user_data); alloc is void*(size_t, void*), free is void(void*, void*). No aligned hook.
allocation.install_constraint: Before ImGui::CreateContext(). Set per module when ImGui is used across DLLs.

diagnostics.log_hook: None at runtime (debug log goes to the in-UI log window).
diagnostics.assert_hook: Compile-time only: IM_ASSERT is a macro fixed when imgui.cpp is compiled (override via IMGUI_USER_CONFIG or imconfig.h).

build_flags.self_check: IMGUI_CHECKVERSION() compares the version and struct sizes the caller was compiled with against the library.

platform.headless: Runs wherever its platform and renderer backends run.
